source_name: Reuters/SEE News syndicated feed on TradingView
why_relevant: SEE News items on MK banks (Uni Banka, Komercijalna, NLB Banka) appear syndicated on TradingView news pages, which are often readable when the SeeNews original is gated — a practical paywall workaround for headline/date/lede capture.

source_name: The Banker (FT) — Bank of the Year awards, North Macedonia
why_relevant: Annual country awards and accompanying write-ups quote the incumbent CEO/management board of the winning MK bank, giving a dated, English-language leadership snapshot. Award entries are also submitted by the banks, so they reveal reorganisation narratives (digital units, new divisions).

source_name: Macedonian Banking Association (MBA / Македонска банкарска асоцијација) — members news & recognitions
why_relevant: Bilingual (mk/en) sector body that republishes international recognitions and member-bank announcements, and whose own governing bodies are staffed by serving bank CEOs/deputy CEOs — so its board list is a cross-check register of who currently holds top posts across MK banks. Confirmed in local search: Toni Stojanovski listed as MBA deputy president alongside his NLB Banka role.

source_name: Nezavisen Vesnik (nezavisen.mk) — business/finance section
why_relevant: General MK daily that covers bank leadership succession with both incoming and outgoing names in the headline ('Тони Стојановски ... на местото на Бранко Грегановиќ'), which is what allows a predecessor/successor chain to be reconstructed — international sources usually name only the incoming person.

source_name: Internet Archive Wayback Machine — archived MK bank 'Управен и Надзорен одбор' pages
why_relevant: The only practical way to reconstruct superseded 'Management/Supervisory Board' pages (kb.mk, stb.com.mk, nlb.mk, sparkasse.mk, halkbank.mk, uni.mk, procredit) and thereby date a change retroactively when neither the bank nor the press announced it. The CDX API allows enumerating every capture of a management URL and diffing names between snapshots.

source_name: NBRNM regulation archive — decisions on consents/licences for bank board members
why_relevant: The central bank hosts consolidated PDFs of the 'Одлука за издавање согласности' and 'Одлука за издавање дозволи' — the fit-and-proper consent regime under which every MK bank management/supervisory board appointment must be approved by the Governor. Defines the legal trigger and paperwork trail that any A5 appointment leaves, and thus tells the collector what document to look for.

source_name: TheBanks.eu — North Macedonia bank profiles
why_relevant: Aggregator maintaining structured English profiles of every MK bank (ownership, parent group, ranking by assets, ownership changes). Ownership/parent-group data is the best predictor of executive turnover — Erste at Sparkasse, Halkbank TR, NLB at Komercijalna — and it normalises the entity list for the whole cell.

source_name: Wikipedia (en + mk) — MK bank and NBRNM articles as pointer/date-anchor
why_relevant: Not a citable source for a personnel fact, but its revision history is a de-facto archive: edits to a bank's or the central bank's infobox ('Governor', 'CEO') timestamp when a change became public, and the cited references point straight to the primary announcement. Also gives biographies of central-bank leadership (e.g. Anita Angelovska-Bezhoska) and the canonical entity list.

source_name: BIS central bankers' speeches archive — NBRNM governor speeches
why_relevant: BIS permanently archives, in English, speeches by NBRNM governors (e.g. Dimitar Bogov, and successors). Speech bylines are an authoritative, dated record of who held the governor's post at a given moment — an international archive that survives NBRNM website redesigns.

source_name: EBA — third-country equivalence annex on North Macedonia
why_relevant: EBA equivalence annexes assess the MK supervisory regime including governance and fit-and-proper requirements for bank management bodies — a rare EU-level, English description of how MK regulates who may sit on a bank board, useful as a rulebook reference for interpreting A5 events.

source_name: US Department of State — Investment Climate Statement, North Macedonia
why_relevant: Annual English monitor with a dedicated financial-sector section describing bank ownership, sector structure and SOE/state-appointment practice; a stable, free, machine-readable alternative to paywalled analyst reports for baseline organisational context.

source_name: Bertelsmann Transformation Index (BTI) — North Macedonia country report
why_relevant: Biennial governance monitor with narrative on state capacity, politicisation of appointments and regulatory independence — the analytical frame for judging whether an MK bank/regulator leadership change is technocratic or political.

source_name: Комерцијална банка АД Скопје — Новости / Медиа центар
why_relevant: First-party newsroom of the largest MK commercial bank; publishes management/board changes, reorganisations, senior appointments and campaign/product news. Media-contact page (/kontakt-mediumi.nspx) identifies the PR function.

source_name: Комерцијална банка — Управен одбор / Менаџмент / Организациска структура
why_relevant: Authoritative roster of the Management Board (Управен одбор), wider management and org structure; diffing this page over time detects leadership moves and reorganisations even when no press release is issued.

source_name: Комерцијална банка — Акционерско собрание (AGM materials)
why_relevant: Legally required publication channel for AGM convocation, agenda and decisions — including election/dismissal of Supervisory Board members. Earliest formal signal of board-level change.

source_name: Комерцијална банка — Вработување (careers)
why_relevant: Own job-ads and internship page; open roles are a leading indicator of hiring appetite, new functions (digital, payments, compliance) and reorganisation.

source_name: Стопанска банка АД Скопје — Новости
why_relevant: First-party newsroom of the NBG-legacy/OTP-owned systemic bank; confirmed to carry CEO-level announcements (e.g. the release naming Хрисула Кутуди as new CEO / chair of the Management Board).

source_name: Стопанска банка — Корпоративно управување (Управен и Надзорен одбор)
why_relevant: Full named roster of the 8-member Management Board with functional portfolios (corporate, retail, risk, transformation & strategy, finance, operations) plus Supervisory Board composition — the cleanest org-map for this bank.

source_name: Стопанска банка — Годишни извештаи / Податоци и извештаи (PDF)
why_relevant: Annual reports and AGM packs (agenda items published as numbered PDFs, e.g. 'точка 10 — годишен извештај') contain governance chapters, board mandates and headcount/organisation detail.

source_name: Стопанска банка — Кариера во СБ
why_relevant: Own vacancy channel; volume and role mix track hiring cycles and new organisational units.

source_name: НЛБ Банка — За акционерите (собрание, капитал, годишни извештаи)
why_relevant: Shareholder section links capital structure, annual financial reports, AGM materials and minutes — the statutory route for supervisory-board elections at NLB Banka.

source_name: НЛБ Банка — Отворени работни позиции
why_relevant: Dedicated open-positions listing (separate from the careers landing page) — the most structured first-party vacancy feed found in this cell; English mirror exists at /en/za-bankata/vrabotuvanje.

source_name: Халкбанк АД Скопје — Новости
why_relevant: Retail-facing newsroom of the Turkish-owned bank (branch openings, service notices, campaigns). Board changes at Halkbank (three new Management Board members; CEO Билал Суџубаши departing after eight years) were picked up by trade press, so the first-party channel must be paired with the corporate site.

source_name: Halkbank Corporate (corporate.halkbank.mk) — За нас / Вработување / Годишни извештаи
why_relevant: Halkbank splits its site: the corporate subdomain carries 'За нас', sustainability, annual reports and an active job-postings section ('Вработување — активни огласи'). Governance and hiring signals live here, not on the retail domain.

source_name: Шпаркасе Банка Македонија — Управен и Надзорен одбор
why_relevant: Named Management Board (incl. Глигор Бишев, Алвин Аличевиќ) and Supervisory Board members of the Erste/Steiermärkische-owned bank. URLs are Cyrillic-percent-encoded .aspx paths — collectors must handle the encoding.

source_name: Шпаркасе Банка — Собрание на акционери (per-session pages)
why_relevant: AGM sessions are published as individually numbered pages ('42_Седница'), which makes the series enumerable — convocations, agendas and decisions on supervisory-board election/compensation.
